title: Quotes backend: schema, versions, workflow operations, cascades
objective: Quotes exist as versioned, lead-subordinate records with the full PRD 10.4 quote operation set, current-quote marking, lead/quote cascade rules in both directions, and Closed Won reachable only via quote Mark won (spec FR-38..FR-40, FR-45..FR-47, FR-49/FR-50).
scope: Quote operations: Assign/Reassign, Send, Revise, MarkWon, MarkLost, Withdraw + QuoteWorkflow matrix
IQuoteCascadeService implementation (lead lost/withdrawn -> open quotes; quote won -> lead + sibling withdrawal; quote lost -> optional lead close)
implementation_details: Liquibase 110-quotes: quotes per spec §11.3 (status_id FK quote-status reference item, is_current bool, unique (tenant_id, quote_ref)); quote_versions (tenant_id, id, quote_id, version_no, quoted_premium numeric(18,2), terms_notes, revision_note, is_current, created_by/at, unique (tenant_id, quote_id, version_no)); quote_assignments; quote_status_history mirroring lead history shape

Features/Quotes/CreateQuote (also invoked by T-019 CreateQuote lead operation): {productLineId/coverTypeId default from lead, quotedPremium required >0, preparedDate required default today >= lead.date_received, validUntil optional, notes} -> quote_ref via ReferenceSequenceService, status Draft (canonical 'draft'), version 1 current, is_current=true on quote (demoting other current quote of the lead only when this is the only open one is NOT done — the 'current' marker: first quote becomes current; MarkWon/Revise maintain it; explicit POST /quotes/{id}/set-current permitted for multi-option quoting per PRD 7.3), quote_assignments defaulted from lead's matching business-assignment roles; side effect: lead before Pricing moves to Pricing (via LeadOperationExecutor)

Domain/Workflow/QuoteWorkflow.cs: matrix from PRD 10.4 quote table (create: lead open; assign: draft/sent/revised; send: draft/revised; revise: sent; mark won/lost: sent/revised; withdraw: draft/sent/revised)

SendQuote: {sentDate default today, validUntil required > sentDate, nextFollowUpDate required (writes lead follow-up)} -> status Sent; when tenant require_pricing_approval_for_high_value and current version premium > high_value_threshold and lead.pricing_approval_state != approved -> 422 PRICING_APPROVAL_REQUIRED; first sent quote on the lead triggers lead -> quote_sent
ReviseQuote: {newQuotedPremium and/or termsNotes (at least one), revisionNote} -> insert quote_versions row version+1 marked current (demote prior), quote status Revised

MarkQuoteWon: {boundPremium required default quoted, decisionDate default today} -> quote Won + bound_premium + decision_date; lead -> closed_won (only path to Closed Won, FR-39); other open quotes of lead -> Withdrawn (dialog confirmation is UI concern; API executes); MarkQuoteLost: {lostReasonId required, competitor?, competitorPremium?, lossComments?, alsoCloseLead bool default computed(no other open quote)} -> quote Lost; when alsoCloseLead and no other open quote -> lead closed_lost via MarkLeadLost path (records lost after quote); WithdrawQuote: {withdrawalNote} -> quote Withdrawn, lead unchanged
QuoteCascadeService implements IQuoteCascadeService from T-019: CascadeLeadLost -> all open quotes Lost (reason inherited 'lead lost', history rows); CascadeLeadWithdrawn -> open quotes Withdrawn
Closed-quote protection: mutations on Won/Lost/Expired/Withdrawn quotes require Quotes.CorrectClosed permission (FR-49); Draft edits via UpdateDraftQuoteCommand only while Draft

Endpoints: POST /api/v1/leads/{id}/quotes, GET /api/v1/leads/{id}/quotes, GET /api/v1/quotes/{id} (detail incl. versions, history, availableOperations), PUT /api/v1/quotes/{id} (draft only), POST /api/v1/quotes/{id}/operations/{op}, POST /api/v1/quotes/{id}/set-current

findings.description: MarkQuoteWon does not promote the won quote to is_current when a DIFFERENT quote was the current one; it only withdraws siblings, leaving is_current on the now-withdrawn sibling. AC-049's numeric invariant ('exactly one current per lead') still holds, and because the lead is Closed Won the current marker no longer feeds open-pipeline rollups, so no practical impact. No spec text (FR-50 covers only Create/Revise) requires promotion here and no acceptance test is violated.
findings.evidence: MarkQuoteWonCommandHandler / QuoteLeadCascade - won quote not set is_current when a sibling was current.
findings.recommendation: If PRD 7.3 dashboard rollups later require the won option to carry the current marker, have MarkQuoteWon promote the won quote to is_current. Non-blocking; flagged for orchestrator/dashboard-task (T-031+) awareness.

MarkWon: bound premium + only-path-to-closed_won (QuoteLeadCascade.MoveLeadToClosedWon, matches V-038) + withdraws sibling open quotes directly. Cascades both directions mutate stores directly (NOT via each other's tx-opening executors, since Npgsql has no nested tx) so a lead-lost cascade onto quotes can never re-trigger lead closure - only explicit MarkQuoteLost(alsoCloseLead) does; recursion prevented. Also implemented BusinessAssignmentStore.HasLiveAssignmentsAsync quote_assignments branch (T-011's deferred NotSupportedException placeholder, now that quote_assignments exists). REAL EF BUG FOUND+FIXED: IQuoteStore.ListOtherOpenQuotes/ListOpenQuotesForLead originally selected the tracked side of a LINQ join (from quote join status select quote) - mutations silently lost on SaveChanges (no error); fixed to resolve ids via no-tracking projection then re-query Quotes by id (fully-tracked single-table) - this is what made MarkWon sibling-withdrawal + lead->quotes cascade actually persist.
